name: e-Kalyan Post-Matric Scholarship — SC / ST Students (Jharkhand)
provider: Department of Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority & Backward Class Welfare, Government of Jharkhand
summary: Jharkhand's post-matric scholarship on the e-Kalyan portal for SC/ST students studying within or outside the state from Class XI onwards.

benefit.details: Maintenance allowance phased by course group; hostellers and professional-course students get higher slabs.

special_conditions: Institution must be registered on the e-Kalyan portal
Applications from outside-state institutions go through the same portal
An NSP One Time Registration (OTR) number is now required before the state portal will accept the application — generate it on scholarships.gov.in using Aadhaar first, it is not instant
Your institute must have completed its own e-Kalyan registration (closed 25 Sep 2026) or it cannot verify your application

steps: Fill academic + bank details and upload documents

notes: Window is 25 August to 20 November 2026 for students; institute registration ran 25 August to 25 September 2026, so an institute that missed its own registration cannot verify your form. Portal ekalyan.cgg.gov.in is confirmed correct. Income ceiling ₹2,50,000 for ST/SC/BC. Helpdesk 1800-599-1289, +91-8409588101, +91-7258010024 (Mon–Fri 11:00–16:00).

name: e-Kalyan Post-Matric Scholarship — OBC Students (Jharkhand)
provider: Backward Class Welfare, Government of Jharkhand
summary: Post-matric scholarship for backward-class students of Jharkhand through the e-Kalyan portal, with a lower notified income ceiling than the SC/ST line.

benefit.details: Maintenance allowance by course group, DBT-credited after verification.

special_conditions: Notified income ceiling for OBC has been revised repeatedly — re-verify the current order
An NSP One Time Registration (OTR) number is now required before the state portal will accept the application — generate it on scholarships.gov.in using Aadhaar first, it is not instant

notes: Same e-Kalyan window as the SC/ST component: 25 Aug – 20 Nov 2026.

name: e-Kalyan Post-Matric Scholarship — Minority Community Students (Jharkhand)
summary: Post-matric support for students from notified minority communities of Jharkhand (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) studying within or outside the state.

benefit.details: Maintenance allowance by course group, DBT-credited.

special_conditions: Jharkhand domicile; institute registered on e-Kalyan
An NSP One Time Registration (OTR) number is now required before the state portal will accept the application — generate it on scholarships.gov.in using Aadhaar first, it is not instant

name: Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda Transnational Scholarship (Jharkhand)
provider: Department of Scheduled Tribe Welfare, Government of Jharkhand
summary: Prestigious overseas scholarship funding Jharkhand's Adivasi/moolvasi students for full-time master's and PhD programmes at leading universities abroad (primarily the UK).

benefit.amount_display: Full overseas tuition + living + travel (₹20–25 lakh+/year scale)
benefit.details: Covers tuition, living costs, visa, insurance and airfare for the selected master's/PhD programme.

special_conditions: ST/SC/moolvasi with Jharkhand domicile (tribal priority per guidelines)
Age below the notified limit at application
Independent admission/shortlisting with approved foreign universities
Bond/service conditions may apply as per the current guidelines

steps: Visa + university formalities with department support

notes: Could not be confirmed against a 2026–27 notification in this review pass. It is administered separately from the e-Kalyan post-matric schedule (which runs to 20 Nov 2026), so the 2027-03-31 date shown here is carried forward from the previous cycle and should be treated as unverified. Check ekalyan.cgg.gov.in or the Jharkhand Tribal Welfare Department before relying on it.

name: e-Kalyan — Post-Matric (Outside-State Institutions) Students of Jharkhand
provider: Department of SC, ST, Minority & BC Welfare, Government of Jharkhand
summary: Dedicated e-Kalyan lane for Jharkhand-domiciled SC/ST/OBC students admitted to recognised institutions outside Jharkhand (NITs, IITs, central universities and other listed institutes).

benefit.details: Maintenance + fee components scaled to the institute category.

special_conditions: Institution must be on the outside-state approved list
Jharkhand domicile + caste certificate from Jharkhand
Fee receipts and hostel certificates from the outside institution
An NSP One Time Registration (OTR) number is now required before the state portal will accept the application — generate it on scholarships.gov.in using Aadhaar first, it is not instant

documents: Admission proof + fee receipts of the outside institute

steps: Map the institution from the approved list

notes: The 'outside state' component follows the same e-Kalyan window, 25 Aug – 20 Nov 2026. Jharkhand domicile students studying elsewhere in India apply here rather than in the within-state component.
